remarks: CHARMING LA CORONA COTTAGE WITH VAULTED CEILINGS, BEAUTIFUL LANDSCAPING AND INVITING OUTDOOR LIVING! Conveniently located near parking and laundry facilities, this delightful La Corona model offers a fabulous floor plan featuring vaulted ceilings in the living room, kitchen and both bedrooms. One of the few models to feature a designated eat-in kitchen, this home combines architectural character, comfort and functionality. A beautifully landscaped walkway surrounded by lush greenery welcomes you to the spacious, covered front patio with its attractive vaulted roofline.
